resumen: The first fight of the raid, with both parties together. Not a regular boss: you destroy a reactor that shields itself with auxiliary reactors while enemies keep spawning. In our 14 nights it always went down on the first attempt; in the 9 we have in detail, in under 4 minutes.

mecanicas.texto: Every so often an auxiliary reactor appears on the left, on the right or in the centre, and while it stands the central reactor barely loses health. An on-screen notice says which one appeared.
mecanicas.como: One or two players, chosen before entering, cross over the jump pads, destroy the auxiliary and come back. Everyone else keeps on the enemies.

mecanicas.texto: The reactor alternates two area attacks, one shaped like a ring and one like a cross or an X, and keeps spawning enemies.
mecanicas.como: Leave the floor markers before they explode.

mecanicas.titulo: What kills most in our logs
mecanicas.texto: The first of these attacks is a 3-second cast bar that hits many players at once and causes over a third of the deaths at the Reactor; the other three trail far behind. They could be the ring and cross areas from the guides, but the log does not record an attack's shape: an unconfirmed inference.
mecanicas.como: If someone dies here, it is almost always to the first one: watch the reactor's cast bar and leave its area before it ends.

dps.texto: If the reactor's health stops dropping, an auxiliary is up: do not spend your big skills there.

todos.texto: It pays to decide before entering who goes for the auxiliaries, so no time is lost when the notice appears.

notas.texto: Guide mechanics are from the previous version (Korea and Early Access). NCSOFT changed mechanics for the 4 November return and there are no guides to the new one yet: anything marked "not seen" may have changed. "Seen" comes from our raids of 6 to 10 November.
